exact_common_fiber_protocol.ambient_order_ideal: For each order pi, clear denominators in v1^pi(a)-v2^pi(a), adjoin all declared ledger equalities, and saturate by principal minors and all ledger, diff-faithfulness, and CI-free disequalities.
exact_common_fiber_protocol.support_formula: F_C,J consists exactly of Sigma in C cap PD_4^2 for which a quantified positive diff-faithful baseline-intervention lift exists for every pi in J and no such lift exists for every pi outside J.
exact_common_fiber_protocol.closure_step: complex Zariski closure of each exact F_C,J, followed by radicalization and primary decomposition
exact_common_fiber_protocol.retention_step: retain D exactly when F_C,J cap D contains a nonempty positive real subset Zariski dense in D
exact_common_fiber_protocol.empty_fiber_certificate: CAD false leaf or real-Nullstellensatz infeasibility certificate
exact_common_fiber_protocol.support_coverage_certificate: the mutually exclusive formulas Pi_C(Sigma)=J over all 16777215 nonempty J partition the realizable CI-free ambient cell
exact_common_fiber_protocol.rejection_certificate: a relatively open positive cell or exact rational arc in F_C,J cap D, with two lifted SCM families at each identical covariance and a target numerator nonzero on that open set

support_exclusion.conclusion: Pi_C_star(Sigma)=J_star on the nonempty Zariski-open positive cell Delta!=0
